SeaWorld Yas Island in Abu Dhabi welcomed Kaya, the region's first Pacific walrus calf, following a 15-month pregnancy. The facility meticulously replicates Arctic conditions to ensure the health of the animals.

The Bright Side:
While marine parks remain ethically debated, this birth advances veterinary knowledge and connects desert audiences directly to fragile Arctic ecosystems.
